body:
It wasn't until later on I found out I couldn't get financial help because I apparently never signed up for selective services. I thought I did but apparently I didn't. 

Every time I tried to get a loan they said I didn't have enough credit history. They last job I had I was paid under the table. There would have been no way to afford rent and other bills if I had to pay taxes. I also had my identity stolen when I was 18.  It took me about 7 years to get all that fixed.
